title: Boiled
body:
Boiled is a simple food mod that adds the Boiler, which can be used to boil different food items and create new dishes!

Credit to [MCreator](https://mcreator.net/) for an easy-to-learn and easy-to-use mod-making system! :D
Join the Discord [here](https://discord.com/invite/ASkVBubyzH) for future updates on my mods!
For more information, visit the [wiki](https://anotherpedia.com/#Boiled%20(Minecraft%20mod))!

Craft yourself a Boiler to boil different food items and make realistic dishes!
![The Boiler surrounded by boiled food items.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/02ed343577425737313bb199815af4e4337e10b3.png)

The Boiler requires time to heat up, with more heat decreasing boil time. Extend the Boiler to make it heat up faster, and heat it passively with hot blocks like Magma Blocks or Lava!
![An extended, heated Boiler.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/94d5e36aab6bfb082216ce91a0dd43602869455c.png)
